name: 02 — Find Emails (contact-page scrape primary, Hunter.io fallback)

nodes.name: Read Scraped Leads
nodes.notes: Reads all leads from Google Sheets where status = 'scraped'. These are leads from workflow 01 that haven't been processed yet.

nodes.name: Has Website?
nodes.notes: Gate: only worth calling Hunter.io if there's a domain to search. No-website leads skip straight to no_email — don't waste the API call (Hunter returns 0% for these anyway).

nodes.name: No Website — Skip Hunter
nodes.notes: Leads with no website are marked no_email immediately, without calling Hunter.io.

nodes.name: Extract Domain
nodes.notes: Extracts clean domain from website URL (strips protocol, www, path). Runs once, feeds both the scrape and the Hunter fallback below.

nodes.name: Hunter.io Domain Search
nodes.notes: Fallback only — runs when the free contact-page scrape above found nothing. Calls Hunter.io Domain Search API, up to 10 emails with confidence scores.

nodes.name: Extract Best Email
nodes.notes: Picks the best email from Hunter.io results. Prioritizes personal over generic, then by confidence score.

nodes.name: Handle Hunter Error
nodes.notes: Handles Hunter.io API failures. Logs the raw error and passes the lead through with empty email.

nodes.name: Email Found?
nodes.notes: Routes leads: Hunter found an email → update sheet. Hunter also found nothing → mark no_email, nothing left to try.

nodes.name: Scrape Contact Pages
nodes.notes: Multi-path scrape: homepage + 4 common English contact-page paths. Extracts emails via regex, prefers domain-matching emails. Now the primary method — Hunter.io only runs if this finds nothing.

nodes.name: Contact Scrape Found Email?
nodes.notes: If the free scrape found an email, skip Hunter.io entirely and go straight to the sheet. Only calls Hunter (paid) when scraping comes up empty.

nodes.name: Mark as Email Found
nodes.notes: Sets status to email_found for leads where the scrape (or, downstream, Hunter) found an email

nodes.name: Update Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Updates each lead row in the Google Sheet with: email, status (email_found or no_email), email_source, email_confidence. Matches by restaurant name.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.notes: Final summary: how many emails found vs not found
